files.purpose: Root manifest of the DroppyCode asset catalog: declares the whole Assets.xcassets folder as an Xcode-authored catalog at version 1, with no namespace or on-demand-resource properties, so every imageset directory beside it is addressed by its bare basename.
side_effects: Compiled into Assets.car by actool at build time; no runtime writes, processes, network or timers
platform_assumptions: Xcode asset catalog (.xcassets) compiled by actool into Assets.car inside the macOS app bundle
"info": {"author": "xcode", "version": 1} is the Xcode catalog manifest envelope
Runtime lookup is by folder basename through SwiftUI Image(_ name:) / AppKit NSImage(named:)
No "properties" key at the root, so provides-namespace is off and asset names stay flat (for example "hydra-head-01", not "hydra/head-01")
feature_notes: Exactly 6 lines, spaced-colon Xcode formatting ("author" : "xcode"), two-space indent, trailing newline
Contains only the info envelope: no "properties", so no catalog-wide namespace, no localization and no appearance defaults
unresolved_questions: This root file does not enumerate its children, so catalog membership is implied by directory layout only; entries such as AppIcon or AccentColor are not visible from here.
